sources.title: When Semantics Regulate: Rethinking Patch Shuffle and Internal Bias for ...
sources.snippet: The technical contribution involves two core interventions. First, the researchers propose semantic-aware patch handling —essentially, being more selective about when and how to shuffle patches. Instead of aggressive random rearrangement, they preserve spatial relationships that maintain image meaning while still providing robustness.

sources.title: Shieldstral: Mistral's 3B Open Safety Model for AI Content Moderation
sources.snippet: What happened Mistral has released Shieldstral, a compact 3-billion-parameter open model designed to monitor AI inputs and outputs for safety violations.
